name: Iseya Souichirou
source:
The young owner of a shipping agency, whose job involves dealing with merchant ships. He's always calm and kind to everyone, but also straightforward and honestly says what's on his mind.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/11/19/yoshiwara-higanbana/]Otome Jikan's character profile translations[/URL].]
